          From everyday to getaway. Faster than ever.

          Turn everyday spending into memorable travel adventures with WestJet points, exclusive perks, and a faster path to top-tier status.

          Card Highlights

          Unlock Travel Savings

          Redeem WestJet points to cover the full or partial cost of your flight (including taxes, fees), vacation packages, and more7. The best part? WestJet points don’t expire.

          Make Every Purchase Count

          Earn faster on everyday essentials like groceries, transportation, and gas3. The more you use your card, the quicker you earn WestJet points and get to your next vacation sooner.

          Enjoy Enhanced Travel Perks

          Enjoy benefits like free checked bags for you and up to eight guests4, earn an annual round-trip companion voucher5 with flexible exchange options and get more peace of mind whenever you fly with comprehensive travel insurance16.

          View All Card Features

          Earn WestJet Points Faster

          2 points

          Earn 2 points for every dollar you spend on WestJet flights, WestJet Vacations, and Sunwing Vacations2.

          New!
          2 points

          Earn 2 points for every dollar you spend at grocery stores and on transportation including gas, EV charging, public transit and rideshare3.

          1.5 points

          Earn 1.5 points for every dollar you spend on all other everyday purchases2.

          Use WestJet Points Your Way

          Fly for Less

          Use your WestJet points to cover all or part of your flight, including taxes, fees, and surcharges. Start redeeming with as few as 2,500 points7.

          Enhance Every Journey

          Redeem your points on seat selection, checked bags, or cabin upgrades7. Enjoy added comfort and convenience every time you take off.

          Unlock Exclusive Deals

          Access Member Exclusive fares available only to WestJet Rewards members and stretch your points further17.

          Use Points Beyond Travel

          Not heading out just yet? Redeem your WestJet points at the WestJet Rewards eStore for gift cards, tech, home essentials, and more from your favourite brands7.

          Make Your Next Travel Story Happen with WestJet

          Enjoy Companion Vouchers & Flexible Exchanges5

          Receive a welcome round-trip companion voucher starting from $119 CAD (plus taxes, fees, charges and other ATC) after first purchase on your card. Your annual companion voucher will be issued each year thereafter when you spend a minimum of $5,000 annually5, or you can choose to exchange it for one of the following:

          • A 30% discount on a base airfare for one traveller8
          • A $200 credit towards a WestJet Vacations package or Sunwing Vacations package9
          • Two lounge passes10

          Check Your Bags for Free4

          Enjoy a free first checked bag for yourself and up to eight guests on the same reservation when you pay with your WestJet RBC World Elite Mastercard4.

          Get a Status Lift11

          For every $5,000 you spend on your card, you’ll get closer to achieving top-tier status with WestJet Rewards by earning $200 in tier qualifying spend11. With status you can enjoy airport lounge access, priority services, complimentary upgrades, and more.

          Access Airport Lounges12

          Use the Mastercard Travel Pass through DragonPass to access more than 1,300 airport lounges around the world, along with special dining and spa offers12.

          Top WestJet RBC World Elite Mastercard Questions

          No, the annual fee for additional cardholders will remain unchanged at $59.

          Yes. Starting November 5, 2025, you will be able to earn 0.5 additional WestJet points per $1 spent on Sunwing Vacations packages, which is a total of 2 WestJet points per $1 spent.

          No. Costco and Walmart are categorized as warehouses, and therefore do not fall under the eligible Merchant Category Code (MCC 5411 Grocery Stores and Supermarkets), Costco and Walmart purchases will not qualify for the additional 0.5 WestJet points per $1 spent. Costco and Walmart purchases will earn the standard 1.5 points per $1 spent.

          For existing primary WestJet RBC World Elite cardholders prior to November 5, 2025, the minimal annual spend will be tracked following the issuance of the annual World Elite companion voucher on or after November 5, 2025 for the subsequent voucher earn year.

          For new WestJet RBC World Elite Mastercard cardholders, the minimal annual spend will be tracked following the issuance of the welcome World Elite companion voucher on or after November 5, 2025 for the subsequent voucher earn year.

          The $5,000 minimum annual spend qualification is all net purchases on the credit card account, less credits and refunds, and excluding cash advances, cash-like transactions, interest charges, fees, credit or debit. If the $5,000 minimum annual spend is met in a given voucher earn year, the annual World Elite companion voucher will be awarded 4-6 weeks after your WestJet RBC World Elite Mastercard annual fee for that year is charged.

          Yes, you can still use your World Elite companion voucher as you do today, including exchanging your companion voucher for lounge vouchers. Please note the number of lounge vouchers will be changed from 4 to 2. In addition, there are now more ways to exchange your companion voucher if desired, including exchanging for A 30% discount on a base airfare for one traveler, or a $200 credit towards a WestJet Vacations or Sunwing Vacations package.

          You can exchange your companion voucher by logging into your WestJet Rewards account on your desktop or mobile app. Select an option and hit submit for an immediate exchange.

          Desktop: Login > Rewards tab > Companion Vouchers tab

          Mobile: Login > Vouchers tab > Companion Vouchers tab

          Nothing. The new Trip Cancellation and Mobile Device insurances will automatically be applied to your WestJet RBC World Elite Mastercard as of November 5, 2025. The coverage will apply to claims incurred on or after November 5, 2025. All claims are subject to the terms, conditions, limitations and exclusions set out in the Certificates of Insurance. For there to be coverage, the mobile device, prepaid travel, accommodations and recreation arrangements must have been purchased with your WestJet RBC World Elite Mastercard card and/or WestJet points. If only a partial payment is made using WestJet points, the entire balance must be paid using your WestJet RBC World Elite Mastercard card for there to be coverage.

          Full details of the recent changes to WestJet Rewards are available at westjet.com/newbenefits
